leads.posting: DailyObjects raises Rs 332 Cr in Series C round led by Xponentia, Anicut, Axiom Asia. Design-led lifestyle-tech brand DailyObjects has raised Rs 332 crore (nearly $35 million) in a Series C funding round led by Xponentia Capital Partners, Anicut Capital and Axiom Asia Private Capital. The round, which comprised primary and secondary transactions, valued the company at around Rs 1,050 crore. The company plans to use the capital to expand its retail network, invest in product development and R&D, strengthen brand building and explore international markets. As part of the round, early investor Roots Ventures partially exited DailyObjects with an 18X return on its investment. It will continue to remain a shareholder in the company alongside 360 One Asset and Trifecta Capital. DailyObjects plans to open 150 exclusive brand outlets (EBOs) across India over the next five years. The company currently has nearly 350 retail touchpoints, including EBOs and Apple Premium Reseller outlets. The company will also invest in new product ranges, design, materials, quality and R&D across its existing categories. DailyObjects started with phone cases and has expanded into technology accessories, carry and workspace products. Founded in 2012 by Pankaj Garg and Saurav Adlakha, DailyObjects has built a portfolio spanning technology, carry, workspace and lifestyle products. The company said it remains focused on capital efficiency and profitable growth as it scales its retail and product operations. DailyObjects has raised nearly $50 million in funding to date, with Seedfund and 360 One Ventures among its key investors. The company last raised $10 million in May 2024. Before the latest round, DailyObjects had raised around Rs 100 crore in equity over the past decade to build and scale its business. leads.posting: OneChronos | Engineering Manager, Data Platform (NYC, Hybrid) · Software Engineer, Quality / SDET (Flexible/U.S. Remote) | Full-Time We’re a Series B trading technology company reimagining how financial markets match buyers and sellers -- applying auction theory and innovative technologies to build fairer, more efficient trading infrastructure. Our production systems are written in Rust and execute billions of dollars in securities transactions daily. If you want to work on genuinely hard problems at the intersection of markets, mechanism design, and distributed systems, we’d love to talk. We’re hiring engineering talent companywide, with a current emphasis on these two roles: Engineering Manager, Data Platform -- Lead and grow our data engineering team while staying close to the code. You’ll own the roadmap for the pipelines, data services, orchestration, and platform infrastructure that power our analytics, and contribute to production systems alongside your team. 8+ years of software or data engineering experience, 2+ managing engineers. Strong Python, SQL, Rust, and TypeScript. Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, Airflow, Dagster or similar) and columnar formats (Parquet, Arrow). Financial markets or exchange experience a strong plus. NYC-based, hybrid. ESTIMATED COMPENSATION: $180,000--$250,000 depending on experience, with eligibility for a discretionary annual bonus. Software Engineer, Quality (SDET) -- Build the quality engineering function from the ground up. You’ll design and own automated test frameworks, CI/CD integrations, staging environments, and validation tooling that help engineers ship with confidence. Proficiency in a systems-level language (Rust, C++, Go, or Java) and Python required. Experience in low-latency or performance-sensitive environments a strong plus. Flexible/U.S. remote. ESTIMATED COMPENSATION: $150,000--$200,000 depending on experience, with eligibility for a discretionary annual bonus. CONTACT: careers@onechronos.com
